verdict.rationale: Luma documents character references in its video model and says Luma Agents carry style references, character references, and visual grounding into every asset so the brand holds steady across generations. That is a first-party cross-shot consistency mechanism, but the evidence consists only of one-line marketing claims with no detail on how well identity or scenes persist between separate clips. Multi-Keyframe applies only within a single clip and does not count toward this story. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how character/scene references work across separate shots, explicit scene-level consistency across shots, and hands-on or independent corroboration of cross-shot consistency.
